definitions.explanation: Something that will never perish, be destroyed, or fade away. Used for achievements, spirit, legacy, and similar abstract concepts.

examples.japanese: {不滅|ふめつ}の{名作|めいさく}だ。
{彼|かれ}の{功績|こうせき}は{不滅|ふめつ}だ。
ベートーヴェンの{音楽|おんがく}は{時代|じだい}を{超|こ}えて{人々|ひとびと}に{愛|あい}される{不滅|ふめつ}の{芸術|げいじゅつ}だ。
examples.english: Beethoven's music is an immortal art loved by people across the ages.

notes:
FORMATION: {不|ふ} (not, non-) + {滅|めつ} (destroy, perish). Literally 'not perishing.'

USAGE: {不滅|ふめつ} is used as a no-adjective ({不滅|ふめつ}の) or as a predicate ({不滅|ふめつ}だ). It has a literary and elevated tone, commonly used for praising lasting achievements or enduring qualities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不滅|ふめつ}の{名作|めいさく}: immortal masterpiece
- {不滅|ふめつ}の{功績|こうせき}: imperishable achievements
- {不滅|ふめつ}の{精神|せいしん}: indestructible spirit
- {不滅|ふめつ}の{記録|きろく}: unbreakable record

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不滅|ふめつ}: imperishable, eternal (literary)
- {永遠|えいえん}: eternity, forever (more general)
- {不朽|ふきゅう}: immortal, everlasting (similar literary register)
- {永久|えいきゅう}: permanent, perpetual
